audit.why: Packet carries 47.23% over 415 games; the entry is written as a losing lane and the HARD / 7-10 rating matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers call Fury of the Sands a single-target ult ('your single-target Fury of the Sands ult ticks on nobody', whys[4] 'your single-target ult finds nobody').
audit.why: Riot's own text for Fury of the Sands is 'unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies ... damages nearby enemies' — it is an aura around Nasus, not a single-target ability. The kit file also carries the zone flag on R.
audit.corrected: Reframed as an ult clock that burns while she is untargetable, dropping the false 'single-target' description.

audit.whatIsWrong: Snip Snip! is described flatly as 'her Q is true damage'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.' Only the centre of the cone is true damage; the outer cone is magic damage, so lateral spacing inside her Q range is a real mitigation Nasus can use while walking her down.
audit.corrected: Added: only the centre of Snip Snip! is true damage, so trade from the edge of the cone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere about Skip 'n Slash's conditional cooldown refund.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.' A Gwen who dashes and connects gets Skip 'n Slash back far sooner; a Gwen who dashes into empty space eats the full 13s at rank 1. For a champion with no dash of his own, denying that hit is the only way Nasus lengthens her re-engage window.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 stage now says: sidestep the dash and she waits the full 13s before she can re-engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defect list: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. breakdown.cooldowns said only 'She's safe inside it. Fight when down.' with no numbers.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist lasts 4 seconds and costs 22/21/20/19/18 seconds. That is the single largest punish window in the lane and it is a countable one — the mist expiring is the cue to Wither, not a vague 'fight when down'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the 4s duration and the 22s rank-1 cooldown with an explicit 'Wither her on expiry' trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line, despite _missing-interactions.json flagging needs-antiheal for this exact pairing.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals Gwen for a portion of the damage it deals to champions, and it procs on every snip of Snip Snip!, so an extended Nasus duel refills her bar for free. Anti-heal timing is what makes the 2+ item duel actually winnable.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to wants.you[2] and to the late-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Stack pure HP' but its description is boilerplate about burning a cooldown, which has nothing to do with itemisation.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts scales off the target's health bar, so raw HP items (and the bonus Health from Fury of the Sands) increase the damage she does to Nasus. Magic resist is the correct answer, which is what the report's Spirit Visage / Mercury's Treads line already recommends.
audit.corrected: Description replaced with the actual reason raw HP is wrong here.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[6] '2+ items' is scored side 'Skill' while its own why says 'you out-duel Gwen on cooldown and three-shot her tower', and the content layer's win[6] is 'Nasus'.
audit.why: The stage text and the content layer both describe a Nasus-favoured stage; 'Skill' contradicts both and understates the one window the player is being told to play for.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side set to Nasus, matching win[6].

audit.why: The mid-game text asserts that Spirit Fire and Fury of the Sands 'tick on nothing' while Gwen sits in Hallowed Mist. Untargetability blocks targeted casts and basic attacks, but whether an already-placed ground zone keeps damaging an untargetable unit is not settled by the kit file and the League Wiki's Hallowed Mist page does not address area damage. Left untouched rather than asserted either way — see notes.
suspectNames flagged 'Soak Siphoning Strike' in early. False positive — Siphoning Strike is Nasus's real Q name per the kit file; 'Soak' is the sentence's verb. No edit made.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — cover lasts 4s, then it is down 22s at rank 1. Wither her on expiry.

edits.before: Still Gwen's window — respect Hallowed Mist fully. Passive lifesteal plus Fleet means she must commit hard to actually dent you; make those commits cost.
edits.after: Still Gwen's window, but Skip 'n Slash only refunds its cooldown if it hits — sidestep the dash and she waits the full 13s before she can re-engage you.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A Thousand Cuts scales with your health bar — raw HP just feeds her damage.

edits.before: Her threat window: Gwen's R recast burst plus Hallowed Mist (W) lets her all-in and then hide untargetable while your single-target Fury of the Sands ult ticks on nobody.
edits.after: Her threat window: Needlework (R) recasts plus Hallowed Mist (W) let her all-in then sit untargetable for 4s, and your Fury of the Sands clock burns while she waits it out.

edits.before: Her R recast burst plus Hallowed Mist lets her all-in then hide untargetable while your single-target ult finds nobody.
edits.after: Needlework recasts plus a 4s Hallowed Mist let her all-in then sit untargetable while your ult clock burns down.

edits.before: Survive to 2+ items where stacked Q plus ult finally out-duels her if she mispositions
edits.after: Reach 2+ items with Grievous Wounds so her passive healing stops out-lasting your stacks

edits.before: This is the one stage you take back. By 2+ items your stacked Siphoning Strike plus Wither plus Spirit Fire armor shred finally out-grinds her IF she misplays — pin her with Wither the moment she's outside Hallowed Mist and you can delete her before she re-enters it. But respect that her Q is true damage: it ignores your bulk, so a Gwen who never overstays her own mist still out-scales you. Make her commit a mistake; she won't lose this fair.
edits.after: This is the one stage you take back. By 2+ items your stacked Siphoning Strike plus Wither plus Spirit Fire armor shred finally out-grinds her IF she misplays — pin her with Wither the moment she's outside Hallowed Mist and you can delete her before she re-enters it. But only the centre of Snip Snip! is true damage, so trade from the edge of the cone, and buy Grievous Wounds: her passive heals her off every hit she lands on you.

notes: UNVERIFIED, left alone: the mid-game text claims Spirit Fire and Fury of the Sands 'tick on nothing' while Gwen is inside Hallowed Mist. The kit file cannot answer this and the Wiki's Hallowed Mist page says only that she is untargetable to enemies outside the mist, with nothing about already-placed area damage. If someone can confirm on the Wiki that ground zones keep damaging an untargetable unit, that sentence in content.mid is wrong and should be rewritten — it currently tells the player their E and R are worthless in that window.
